papers.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of human papillomavirus genotype distribution in condyloma acuminata: divergent profiles in HIV-positive and HIV-negative patients
papers.abstract: Condyloma acuminata, chiefly linked to low-risk human papillomavirus (LR-HPV), demonstrates a more severe clinical course – characterized by extensive lesions, recurrence, and treatment resistance–in HIV individuals. This group also shows increased high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) infection and coinfection prevalence, elevating oncogenic risk. This review aimed to compare HPV subtype profiles between HIV-positive and HIV-negative patients to guide clinical strategies. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted, querying PubMed, ScienceDirect, Cochrane/CENTRAL, and Google Scholar for literature published from 2015 to 2025. Six studies involving 703 participants were included. Data were synthesized using a random-effects model in RevMan 5.4.1 to generate pooled odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals. Methodological quality was evaluated via ROBINS-I and SIGN tools. Results demonstrated that HIV status was a significant determinant of HPV genotype distribution. Individuals living with HIV had substantially higher frequencies of HR-HPV infections (e.g. genotypes 16, 18, 52, 59) compared with HIV-negative individuals, in whom LR-HPV types predominated (pooled odds ratio: 5.25; 95% confidence interval: 3.10–8.88; P <0.001). In summary, these findings confirm a distinct HR-HPV predominance in individuals living with HIV, underscoring the imperative for enhanced, tailored screening, and preventive oncology measures in this high-risk group.

papers.title_zh: 尖锐湿疣中人乳头瘤病毒基因型分布的系统综述和荟萃分析:HIV阳性与HIV阴性患者中不同的分布特征
papers.source_body_en: Condyloma acuminata, chiefly linked to low-risk human papillomavirus (LR-HPV), demonstrates a more severe clinical course – characterized by extensive lesions, recurrence, and treatment resistance–in HIV individuals. This group also shows increased high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) infection and coinfection prevalence, elevating oncogenic risk. This review aimed to compare HPV subtype profiles between HIV-positive and HIV-negative patients to guide clinical strategies. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted, querying PubMed, ScienceDirect, Cochrane/CENTRAL, and Google Scholar for literature published from 2015 to 2025. Six studies involving 703 participants were included. Data were synthesized using a random-effects model in RevMan 5.4.1 to generate pooled odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals. Methodological quality was evaluated via ROBINS-I and SIGN tools. Results demonstrated that HIV status was a significant determinant of HPV genotype distribution. Individuals living with HIV had substantially higher frequencies of HR-HPV infections (e.g. genotypes 16, 18, 52, 59) compared with HIV-negative individuals, in whom LR-HPV types predominated (pooled odds ratio: 5.25; 95% confidence interval: 3.10–8.88; P <0.001). In summary, these findings confirm a distinct HR-HPV predominance in individuals living with HIV, underscoring the imperative for enhanced, tailored screening, and preventive oncology measures in this high-risk group.
papers.abstract_zh: 尖锐湿疣主要与低危型人乳头瘤病毒(LR-HPV)相关,但在HIV感染者中表现出更严重的临床过程,特征包括广泛病变、复发和对治疗的抵抗。该群体还表现出更高的高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染率以及与多种病毒的共感染,从而增加致癌风险。本综述旨在比较HIV阳性与HIV阴性患者中人乳头瘤病毒亚型的分布情况,以指导临床策略。进行了系统综述和荟萃分析,检索了PubMed、ScienceDirect、Cochrane/CENTRAL和Google Scholar等数据库中2015年至2025年发表的文献。共纳入6项研究,涉及703名参与者。使用RevMan 5.4.1中的随机效应模型对数据进行综合分析,以生成95%置信区间下的汇总比值比。通过ROBINS-I和SIGN工具评估方法学质量。结果显示,HIV状态是人乳头瘤病毒基因型分布的重要决定因素。与HIV阴性个体相比,HIV阳性个体中高危型人乳头瘤病毒(如基因型16、18、52、59)的感染频率显著更高,而HIV阴性个体中则以低危型人乳头瘤病毒为主(汇总比值比:5.25;95%置信区间:3.10–8.88;P <0.001)。总之,这些发现证实了HIV感染者中高危型人乳头瘤病毒的显著优势,强调了对该高危群体加强针对性筛查和预防性肿瘤学措施的必要性。

papers.title: Intratumoral Human Papillomavirus in Advanced Prostate Cancer: Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Real-World Evidence from the Largest Cohort to Date
papers.abstract: The etiopathogenesis of prostate cancer (PCa) is complex and involves multiple hormonal and environmental factors. Among these, the role of infectious agents remains controversial. Human papillomavirus (HPV) is known to promote carcinogenesis in epithelial tumors and has also been detected, albeit inconsistently, in PCa tissues. This systematic review, meta-analysis, and real-world cohort study aimed to clarify the prevalence and the prognostic role of intratumoral (IT)-HPV detection in locally advanced and metastatic PCa. We performed a systematic literature search including studies reporting IT-HPV detection in locally advanced (LA-PCa) and metastatic PCa (mPCa). Pooled prevalence estimates were calculated using random-effects models. In parallel, HPV DNA was analyzed using archival tissue in a single-center real-world retrospective cohort of 196 metastatic PCa patients. Twenty-three records met the inclusion criteria, comprising 22 full-text publications and one abstract. Nineteen datasets, encompassing 837 patients, contributed to the quantitative synthesis of stage III–IV disease. Pooled IT-HPV prevalence in mPCa was 18.5% (95% CI, 6.4–34%), while including also LA-PCa was 14.6% (95% CI, 5.2–26.8). Eastern countries showed higher IT-HPV prevalence in both mPCa and LA-PCa (40% and 34.3%, respectively) compared with Western regions (0.8% and 0.3%; p 7) in advanced stage (pooled OR 6.32, 95% CI, 3.13–12.78) compared with IT-HPV-negative PCa; however, no studies reported data on its association with survival outcomes. Within our retrospective cohort, IT-HPV DNA was detected in 3.1% of cases (6/196) and exhibited typical PCa driver alterations, such as TP53, SPOP, PIK3CA, and AR amplification. IT–HPV seems to be infrequent in metastatic and locally advanced PCa in Western populations and more prevalent in Asian cohorts and might be associated with a higher Gleason score. IT–HPV-positive advanced PCa seems to exhibit typical PCa driver alterations. Data on the association between IT–HPV status and survival outcomes in PCa are lacking. Standardized molecular assays and multicenter prospective studies are needed to delineate its significance in PCa.

papers.title: Diagnostic utility of high-risk HPV polymerase chain reaction-based testing in head and neck FNA specimens with indeterminate cytomorphology.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is critical in the initial diagnosis of many high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV)-associated, metastatic oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas. Updated guidelines recommend HR-HPV-specific polymerase chain reaction (PCR) analysis over p16 immunohistochemistry on FNA specimens because p16 performs poorly on cytology material. PCR-based assays on liquid cytology material have demonstrated excellent analytic performance; however, the diagnostic utility of a positive HR-HPV PCR result in specimens with indeterminate cytomorphology remains uncharacterized. METHODS: The authors retrospectively identified 279 head and neck FNA specimens that had paired HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material over a 5-year period. The positive predictive value for histopathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma on surgical follow-up was calculated within each cytologic interpretive category. RESULTS: The HR-HPV PCR results were positive in 50.2% of specimens, negative in 40.9%, and indeterminate in 9.0%. The HR-HPV positivity rate ranged from 0% in specimens categorized as negative for malignancy to 57.3% in cytologically positive specimens, with 19.0%, 41.2%, and 50.0% positivity in the atypical, suspicious, and nondiagnostic categories, respectively. Among cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results (n = 14), the positive predictive value was 100% (95% confidence interval, 78.5%-100.0%). Blinded slide review additionally identified 15 cytologically positive specimens in which the definitive malignant interpretation depended substantially on HR-HPV positivity; all 15 were confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma. CONCLUSIONS: A positive HR-HPV PCR result on liquid cytology material carries a positive predictive value of 100% for malignancy in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens. These findings support integrating HR-HPV PCR analysis into routine cytologic interpretation with the potential to upgrade some indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected, expediting definitive treatment and sparing patients additional, invasive sampling.

papers.title_zh: 头颈部细针穿刺(FNA)标本细胞形态学不确定时高危型HPV聚合酶链反应检测的诊断价值
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Fine-needle aspiration (FNA) is critical in the initial diagnosis of many high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV)-associated, metastatic oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas. Updated guidelines recommend HR-HPV-specific polymerase chain reaction (PCR) analysis over p16 immunohistochemistry on FNA specimens because p16 performs poorly on cytology material. PCR-based assays on liquid cytology material have demonstrated excellent analytic performance; however, the diagnostic utility of a positive HR-HPV PCR result in specimens with indeterminate cytomorphology remains uncharacterized. METHODS: The authors retrospectively identified 279 head and neck FNA specimens that had paired HR-HPV PCR testing on residual liquid cytology material over a 5-year period. The positive predictive value for histopathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma on surgical follow-up was calculated within each cytologic interpretive category. RESULTS: The HR-HPV PCR results were positive in 50.2% of specimens, negative in 40.9%, and indeterminate in 9.0%. The HR-HPV positivity rate ranged from 0% in specimens categorized as negative for malignancy to 57.3% in cytologically positive specimens, with 19.0%, 41.2%, and 50.0% positivity in the atypical, suspicious, and nondiagnostic categories, respectively. Among cytologically indeterminate specimens with positive HR-HPV PCR results (n = 14), the positive predictive value was 100% (95% confidence interval, 78.5%-100.0%). Blinded slide review additionally identified 15 cytologically positive specimens in which the definitive malignant interpretation depended substantially on HR-HPV positivity; all 15 were confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma. CONCLUSIONS: A positive HR-HPV PCR result on liquid cytology material carries a positive predictive value of 100% for malignancy in cytologically indeterminate head and neck FNA specimens. These findings support integrating HR-HPV PCR analysis into routine cytologic interpretation with the potential to upgrade some indeterminate specimens to malignant when HR-HPV is detected, expediting definitive treatment and sparing patients additional, invasive sampling.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:细针穿刺(FNA)在多种高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)相关、转移性或原发性口咽鳞状细胞癌的初始诊断中至关重要。更新后的指南建议在FNA标本中采用HR-HPV特异性聚合酶链反应(PCR)分析而非p16免疫组化检测,因为p16在细胞学标本中的表现欠佳。基于液体细胞学标本的PCR检测已显示出优异的分析性能;然而,在细胞形态学不确定的标本中,阳性HR-HPV PCR结果的诊断价值仍未得到明确。方法:作者回顾性识别出5年内共279例头颈部FNA标本,这些标本均进行了配对的HR-HPV PCR检测(基于剩余液体细胞学标本)。在每个细胞学解释类别中,计算外科随访确诊鳞状细胞癌的阳性预测值。结果:HR-HPV PCR结果在50.2%的标本中为阳性,40.9%为阴性,9.0%为不确定。HR-HPV阳性率在各细胞学解释类别中存在差异:在诊断为恶性的标本中为57.3%,而在诊断为非恶性的标本中为0%;在“非典型”“可疑”和“无诊断意义”类别中,阳性率分别为19.0%、41.2%和50.0%。在细胞学不确定且HR-HPV PCR阳性的标本中(n=14),恶性的阳性预测值为100%(95%置信区间,78.5%-100.0%)。盲法玻片复核还识别出15例细胞学阳性标本,其明确的恶性诊断在很大程度上依赖于HR-HPV阳性结果;所有15例标本均被确诊为鳞状细胞癌。结论:在细胞形态学不确定的头颈部FNA标本中,液体细胞学标本上HR-HPV PCR阳性结果对恶性肿瘤的阳性预测值为100%。这些发现支持将HR-HPV PCR分析纳入常规细胞学诊断流程,在检测到HR-HPV时可将部分不确定标本升级为恶性诊断,从而加速确定性诊断并减少患者的侵入性取样需求。

papers.title: Association Between Female Genital Schistosomiasis and High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Among Women of Reproductive Age in Zambia: The Schista Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Female genital schistosomiasis (FGS), a gynecological disease caused by Schistosoma haematobium egg deposition in the female genital tract, is prevalent in sub-Saharan Africa, the region with the highest cervical cancer burden globally. Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is necessary for cervical cancer development. We determined the association between FGS and HR-HPV genotypes in Zambian women. METHODS: Sexually active women aged 15-50 years, not menstruating or pregnant, were recruited at home and provided 2 cervicovaginal self-swabs, urine sample, and HIV and Trichomonas vaginalis self-tests, and completed a questionnaire. In clinic, midwives collected cervicovaginal swabs and cervical images with point-of-care colposcopy (EVA System, MobileODT). Swabs were analyzed for 14 HR-HPV types (GeneXpert) and Schistosoma DNA (ITS-2 real-time polymerase chain reaction [qPCR]); urine was analyzed for Schistosoma ova by microscopy and circulating anodic antigen. Visual FGS was defined as colposcopic identification of specific genital lesions, and molecular FGS as Schistosoma-positive cervicovaginal qPCR. RESULTS: Among 2532 women (median age, 28 [interquartile range, 22-36] years) recruited at home, 1694 (67%) completed clinic follow-up. Prevalence of visual FGS, molecular FGS, and HR-HPV was 35.2% (595/1691), 6.5% (165/2532), and 28.7% (690/2401), respectively. Molecular FGS was weakly associated with all HR-HPV (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 1.3 [95% confidence interval {CI}, .9-1.9]). Women with molecular FGS were more likely to test positive for HR-HPV types 16/18/45 (aOR, 1.7 [95% CI, 1.0-2.8]). No association was observed between visual FGS and HR-HPV infection (95% CI, .7-1.1). CONCLUSIONS: This is the first study to jointly screen for FGS and HR-HPV in Zambia, reporting an association between oncogenic HR-HPV types and molecular FGS.

papers.title_zh: 赞比亚育龄女性中女性生殖器血吸虫病与高危型HPV感染的关联:Schista研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Female genital schistosomiasis (FGS), a gynecological disease caused by Schistosoma haematobium egg deposition in the female genital tract, is prevalent in sub-Saharan Africa, the region with the highest cervical cancer burden globally. Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is necessary for cervical cancer development. We determined the association between FGS and HR-HPV genotypes in Zambian women. METHODS: Sexually active women aged 15-50 years, not menstruating or pregnant, were recruited at home and provided 2 cervicovaginal self-swabs, urine sample, and HIV and Trichomonas vaginalis self-tests, and completed a questionnaire. In clinic, midwives collected cervicovaginal swabs and cervical images with point-of-care colposcopy (EVA System, MobileODT). Swabs were analyzed for 14 HR-HPV types (GeneXpert) and Schistosoma DNA (ITS-2 real-time polymerase chain reaction [qPCR]); urine was analyzed for Schistosoma ova by microscopy and circulating anodic antigen. Visual FGS was defined as colposcopic identification of specific genital lesions, and molecular FGS as Schistosoma-positive cervicovaginal qPCR. RESULTS: Among 2532 women (median age, 28 [interquartile range, 22-36] years) recruited at home, 1694 (67%) completed clinic follow-up. Prevalence of visual FGS, molecular FGS, and HR-HPV was 35.2% (595/1691), 6.5% (165/2532), and 28.7% (690/2401), respectively. Molecular FGS was weakly associated with all HR-HPV (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 1.3 [95% confidence interval {CI}, .9-1.9]). Women with molecular FGS were more likely to test positive for HR-HPV types 16/18/45 (aOR, 1.7 [95% CI, 1.0-2.8]). No association was observed between visual FGS and HR-HPV infection (95% CI, .7-1.1). CONCLUSIONS: This is the first study to jointly screen for FGS and HR-HPV in Zambia, reporting an association between oncogenic HR-HPV types and molecular FGS.

papers.title: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' Exploring the acceptability of future Human Papillomavirus self-sampling, and the barriers and facilitators of cervical cancer screening for those with intellectual disabilities in Scotland.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 的 宫颈癌 筛查出勤率约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比率和世界卫生组织建议的 70% 目标。HPV 自我采样可以为这一服务不足的人群提供更方便的筛查选择。本研究旨在了解患有 ID 的女性对 宫颈癌 筛查以及 HPV 自我采样的可接受性的看法和经验。方法:利用焦点小组对参与苏格兰第三部门社区团体的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,共有 13 名参与者(11 名患有智力障碍的女性,2 名护理人员)。使用反思性主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:出现了五个主题:(1) 国家卫生服务 (NHS) 沟通是痛苦的根源;(2) 医疗保健提供者和智障妇女之间的权力失衡:感觉被忽视、被忽视和失控;(3) 护理不足造成的持久后果;(4)过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;(5) 自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。结论:这项研究揭示了当前 宫颈癌 针对 ID 女性的筛查服务存在显着的系统性缺陷,同时强调了自我采样的变革潜力。成功的实施需要全面的可获取信息、加强的医疗保健专业培训和创伤知情护理方法。自我采样可以显着推进健康公平目标,同时改善这一服务不足人群的医疗保健结果。

papers.title: One dose, one billion girls: the scientific and public health imperative of India’s single dose human Papillomavirus vaccination strategy
papers.abstract: Cervical cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer mortality in women across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). In India, an estimated 1,27,526 new cases and 79,906 deaths were recorded in 2022, accounting for approximately 19% of the global burden.1 Every day, nearly 200 Indian women lose their lives to a disease that a vaccine can prevent. Against this backdrop, the phased introduction of the human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine under India's Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP), following the Union Budget announcement in February 2024 and sustained advocacy by the National Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation (NTAGI), represents a watershed moment in preventive oncology.
papers.journal: International Journal Of Community Medicine And Public Health

The phased introduction of the HPV vaccine under India's Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP) following the Union Budget announcement in February 2024 and sustained advocacy by the National Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation (NTAGI) is presented as a critical step in preventive oncology. The authors interpret this as a strong justification for the single dose strategy, given its potential to reduce the disease burden. The study underscores the scientific and public health significance of this approach in addressing cervical cancer. However, the evidence is based on policy implementation and advocacy, without detailed statistical or methodological analysis, which limits its strength.

elements_zh.main_results: 本研究强调,在宫颈癌负担如此之高的印度,推行HPV 疫苗接种策略具有关键意义,这种单剂策略有望显著降低该疾病的负担。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为在印度采用单剂HPV 疫苗接种策略的有力依据,强调其应对宫颈癌带来的重大公共卫生挑战的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为在印度实施单剂HPV 疫苗接种策略提供了科学和公共卫生的必要性依据,以应对高发的HPV相关宫颈癌的发病率和死亡率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于在全民免疫计划(UIP)中引入HPV 疫苗的情况,未包含详细的统计或方法学分析,这限制了证据的强度。

papers.title: Human Papillomavirus Positivity and Genotype Distribution Among Korean Females: A Large-Scale Laboratory-Based Analysis
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV) genotype distribution is an important epidemiologic indicator for guiding public health surveillance, yet large-scale, laboratory-based data among Korean females remain limited, particularly following the incorporation of HPV vaccination into the National Immunization Program in 2016. This study evaluated HPV positivity and genotype distribution among clinically tested Korean females using a large-scale laboratory-based dataset. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 530,808 HPV genotyping results from Korean females tested between 2014 and 2022 using the AnyplexTM II HPV 28 Detection system (Seegene, Seoul, Republic of Korea). Specimens were classified as high-risk (HR), low-risk (LR), or multiple-type infections, and the proportion of specimens containing at least one HR genotype not included in the 9-valent vaccine was determined. Results: The overall HPV positivity rate was 44.4%, with a U-shaped age distribution. HPV 52 was the most frequently detected genotype (7.2%), followed by HPV 53 (6.3%) and HPV 58 (5.1%). Multiple-type infections were identified in 45.4% of HPV-positive specimens, and 24.4% of specimens harbored at least one HR genotype not included in the 9-valent vaccine. Conclusions: This large-scale laboratory-based analysis provides updated epidemiologic data on HPV positivity and genotype distribution among clinically tested Korean females. As this cohort reflects clinically tested rather than population-based specimens, these findings should be interpreted as descriptive observations that support continued surveillance of circulating HPV genotypes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒,HPV)基因型分布是指导公共卫生监测的重要流行病学指标,但目前关于韩国女性的大规模、基于实验室的数据仍较为有限,尤其是在2016年人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种纳入国家免疫接种计划之后。本研究利用一项大规模基于实验室的数据集,评估了临床检测中韩国女性的人乳头瘤病毒阳性率及基因型分布。方法:回顾性分析了2014年至2022年间使用AnyplexTM II HPV 28检测系统(Seegene,韩国首尔)检测的530,808例韩国女性的HPV基因型检测结果。样本被分为高危型(HR)、低危型(LR)或多重感染类型,并计算了至少包含一种未包含在9价疫苗中的高危型基因型的样本比例。结果:总体HPV阳性率为44.4%,呈U型年龄分布。最常检测到的基因型是HPV 52(7.2%),其次是HPV 53(6.3%)和HPV 58(5.1%)。在HPV阳性样本中,45.4%为多重感染,24.4%的样本含有至少一种未包含在9价疫苗中的高危型基因型。结论:这项大规模基于实验室的分析提供了关于临床检测中韩国女性HPV阳性率和基因型分布的最新流行病学数据。由于这些样本是临床检测而非基于人群的样本,这些发现应被视为描述性观察结果,支持对流行HPV基因型的持续监测。

papers.title: An Analysis of Multilevel Barriers to Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Uptake Among Rural U.S. Adolescents
papers.abstract: Despite longstanding vaccine availability, human papillomavirus (HPV) remains the most common sexually transmitted infection in the United States and a leading cause of preventable cancers. Additionally, HPV vaccination rates remain below other routinely recommended adolescent immunizations, particularly in rural populations. This study aimed to identify barriers related to healthcare access, socioeconomic conditions, cultural beliefs, and provider–patient communication in rural communities. A bibliographical review of articles published in English from 2020 to 2025 and an analysis of national datasets were conducted to establish trends in HPV vaccination rates. State-level HPV vaccination data for adolescents aged 13–17 years were obtained from America’s Health Rankings and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention National Immunization Survey-Teen. States were classified as predominantly rural or urban using Rural–Urban Continuum Codes, and mean vaccination completion rates were compared. The mean HPV vaccination completion rate was lower in rural states (60.55%) compared to urban states (67.31%); however, this difference did not meet the selected threshold for statistical significance (p = 0.025). Barriers identified in the literature included reduced access to healthcare, differences in provider communication, socioeconomic constraints, and limited health literacy in rural communities. Of the identified barriers, healthcare provider recommendations emerged as one of the strongest predictors of vaccine acceptance. These findings highlight multilevel determinants contributing to differences in HPV vaccine uptake and underscore the need for targeted, evidence-based strategies to improve vaccine access and coverage in underserved adolescent populations.

papers.title_zh: 美国农村青少年中多层级阻碍人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种的分析
papers.source_body_en: Despite longstanding vaccine availability, human papillomavirus (HPV) remains the most common sexually transmitted infection in the United States and a leading cause of preventable cancers. Additionally, HPV vaccination rates remain below other routinely recommended adolescent immunizations, particularly in rural populations. This study aimed to identify barriers related to healthcare access, socioeconomic conditions, cultural beliefs, and provider–patient communication in rural communities. A bibliographical review of articles published in English from 2020 to 2025 and an analysis of national datasets were conducted to establish trends in HPV vaccination rates. State-level HPV vaccination data for adolescents aged 13–17 years were obtained from America’s Health Rankings and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention National Immunization Survey-Teen. States were classified as predominantly rural or urban using Rural–Urban Continuum Codes, and mean vaccination completion rates were compared. The mean HPV vaccination completion rate was lower in rural states (60.55%) compared to urban states (67.31%); however, this difference did not meet the selected threshold for statistical significance (p = 0.025). Barriers identified in the literature included reduced access to healthcare, differences in provider communication, socioeconomic constraints, and limited health literacy in rural communities. Of the identified barriers, healthcare provider recommendations emerged as one of the strongest predictors of vaccine acceptance. These findings highlight multilevel determinants contributing to differences in HPV vaccine uptake and underscore the need for targeted, evidence-based strategies to improve vaccine access and coverage in underserved adolescent populations.

papers.title: Physicians’ role in recommending Human Papillomavirus Vaccination—a qualitative study in the context of national immunization rollout
papers.abstract: In September 2025, Pakistan launched a nationwide HPV immunization campaign targeting 13 million girls aged 9–14 years. However, vaccine hesitancy and misconceptions remain significant barriers. This qualitative study aimed to explore physicians' role in recommending Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination and identify sociocultural and professional factors influencing vaccine acceptance. A qualitative exploratory study was conducted using face-to-face, semi-structured interviews with 20 physicians from public and private healthcare settings in Islamabad and Rawalpindi between November 2025 and February 2026. Participants were recruited through convenience sampling. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed verbatim, and analyzed using the six-step thematic analysis approach of Braun and Clarke's framework. Thematic analysis revealed six key domains: (1) Awareness and knowledge gaps (profound public unawareness and physician knowledge deficits); (2) Perceptions of HPV as a public health issue (recognition of disease burden constrained by social taboos); (3) Views on vaccine safety and effectiveness (strong confidence in global safety data undermined by absence of Pakistan-specific evidence); (4) Barriers to vaccination (cultural and religious misconceptions, infertility myths, professional and systemic shortcomings); (5) Motivations for recommending the vaccine (prevention of cervical cancer and professional ethical duty); and (6) Strategies to reduce hesitancy (grassroots education campaigns, religious leader engagement, healthcare provider training, and multi-sectoral government-led approaches). Physicians in this study reported that HPV vaccination in Pakistan is challenged by knowledge gaps, sociocultural barriers, persistent misconceptions, and limited locally generated findings. Despite these challenges, respondents demonstrated strong motivation to recommend HPV vaccination based on professional responsibility and the perceived burden of cervical cancer. These findings suggest that culturally sensitive awareness initiatives, healthcare provider training, engagement of religious and community leaders, and investment in Pakistan-specific research may facilitate HPV vaccine acceptance during the national immunization campaign.

source_records.abstract: In September 2025, Pakistan launched a nationwide HPV immunization campaign targeting 13 million girls aged 9–14 years. However, vaccine hesitancy and misconceptions remain significant barriers. This qualitative study aimed to explore physicians' role in recommending Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination and identify sociocultural and professional factors influencing vaccine acceptance. A qualitative exploratory study was conducted using face-to-face, semi-structured interviews with 20 physicians from public and private healthcare settings in Islamabad and Rawalpindi between November 2025 and February 2026. Participants were recruited through convenience sampling. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed verbatim, and analyzed using the six-step thematic analysis approach of Braun and Clarke's framework. Thematic analysis revealed six key domains: (1) Awareness and knowledge gaps (profound public unawareness and physician knowledge deficits); (2) Perceptions of HPV as a public health issue (recognition of disease burden constrained by social taboos); (3) Views on vaccine safety and effectiveness (strong confidence in global safety data undermined by absence of Pakistan-specific evidence); (4) Barriers to vaccination (cultural and religious misconceptions, infertility myths, professional and systemic shortcomings); (5) Motivations for recommending the vaccine (prevention of cervical cancer and professional ethical duty); and (6) Strategies to reduce hesitancy (grassroots education campaigns, religious leader engagement, healthcare provider training, and multi-sectoral government-led approaches). Physicians in this study reported that HPV vaccination in Pakistan is challenged by knowledge gaps, sociocultural barriers, persistent misconceptions, and limited locally generated findings. Despite these challenges, respondents demonstrated strong motivation to recommend HPV vaccination based on professional responsibility and the perceived burden of cervical cancer. These findings suggest that culturally sensitive awareness initiatives, healthcare provider training, engagement of religious and community leaders, and investment in Pakistan-specific research may facilitate HPV vaccine acceptance during the national immunization campaign.

analysis.summary_en: This qualitative study explored the role of physicians in recommending Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination in Pakistan during a nationwide immunization campaign launched in September 2025. The research aimed to identify sociocultural and professional factors influencing vaccine acceptance. Conducted between November 2025 and February 2026, the study involved 20 physicians from public and private healthcare settings in Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Using Braun and Clarke's thematic analysis framework, interviews were analyzed to uncover key domains such as awareness gaps, perceptions of HPV as a public health issue, vaccine safety concerns, barriers to vaccination, motivations for recommendation, and strategies to reduce hesitancy. The results indicated that physicians face challenges including knowledge deficits, cultural and religious misconceptions, and a lack of locally generated evidence on HPV. Despite these challenges, they showed strong motivation to recommend the vaccine due to its role in preventing cervical cancer and their professional ethical duty. The study suggests that culturally sensitive awareness campaigns, provider training, and government-led initiatives could enhance HPV vaccine acceptance. However, the use of convenience sampling limits the generalizability of the findings, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the qualitative nature of the data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨医生在推荐人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种中的作用,并识别影响疫苗接受度的社会文化及专业因素。背景强调了巴基斯坦全国性HPV免疫接种运动的启动以及疫苗犹豫不决和误解等持续存在的障碍。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究采用定性探索性方法,于2025年11月至2026年2月期间,通过面对面、半结构化访谈的方式,对来自伊斯兰堡和拉瓦尔品第公共和私人医疗环境的20名医生进行了调查。研究重点在于理解与HPV 疫苗接种推荐相关的挑战和动机。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者通过便利抽样招募。访谈内容被录音、逐字转录,并采用Braun和Clarke框架的六步主题分析方法进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 主题分析揭示了六个关键领域:(1)意识与知识差距,(2)对HPV作为公共卫生问题的看法,(3)对疫苗安全性和有效性的看法,(4)推荐疫苗接种的障碍,(5)推荐疫苗的动机,以及(6)减少犹豫不决的策略。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,文化敏感性的意识提升活动、医疗人员培训、宗教和社区领袖的参与以及加大对巴基斯坦本土研究的投资,可能有助于提高HPV 疫苗在国家免疫接种运动中的接受度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可用于制定有针对性的策略,以提高HPV 疫苗的接受度,包括解决知识差距、文化障碍,并提升巴基斯坦医疗人员的培训水平。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了便利抽样,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于研究基于定性访谈而非定量数据,其证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Implementation of the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccination Program to Enhance Primary Prevention of Cervical Cancer among the Academic Community and the Public at the Faculty of Medicine, Mitra Bunda Institute of Health Sciences
papers.abstract: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection is a primary cause of cervical cancer, which remains a significant public health issue in Indonesia. Primary prevention efforts through HPV vaccination need to be continuously enhanced by engaging educational institutions as partners in health promotion. The activity was conducted from February 6–8, 2026, at the Faculty of Medicine, Mitra Bunda Health Institute, Batam, comprising stages of registration, health screening, education, vaccination, and observation for Adverse Events Following Immunization (AEFI). The target audience included students, the academic community, and the general public. A total of 400 participants registered, and 338 successfully received the HPV vaccine; no severe AEFIs were reported during the event. This program demonstrates that collaboration between educational institutions and healthcare professionals can support increased vaccination coverage and strengthen primary prevention efforts against cervical cancer through integrated education and healthcare services.

papers.title: Off-Label HPV Vaccination in a 67-Year-Old Woman with Recurrent HPV Infection
papers.abstract: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is a highly prevalent sexually transmitted infection associated with malignancies of the cervix, vulva, and vagina. While prophylactic vaccination with Gardasil®9 is FDA-approved through age 45, no clinical trials have evaluated its use in older adults who remain sexually active and at risk for HPV-related cancers. We describe the case of a woman who presented with recurrent high-risk HPV and received the three-dose Gardasil®9 series off-label at the age of 67. Following vaccination, her cervical cytology was negative for HPV and subsequent colposcopy did not demonstrate any evidence of intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. As this is a single case report, this temporal association cannot establish that vaccination caused viral clearance. Nonetheless, this case raises important questions regarding age-based HPV vaccination limits. Immunosenescence in older populations may impair viral clearance and could increase cumulative risk of progression from dysplasia to malignancy. Vaccination may therefore serve both prophylactic and potentially therapeutic roles; however, this must be evaluated in further controlled studies. This case highlights the need for further research into HPV vaccination in patients over the age of 45 years with or without history of HPV infection.

analysis.methods: The case involved the administration of the Gardasil®9 vaccine off-label to a 67-year-old woman with recurrent high-risk HPV. The patient's cervical cytology and colposcopy results were used to assess the impact of vaccination on HPV status.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that HPV vaccination may have therapeutic potential in older adults with recurrent infections, which could inform future studies on expanding vaccination guidelines for HPV-related cancers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As this is a single case report, the evidence is limited and cannot establish causality. The study lacks controlled comparisons and generalizability, which reduces the strength of the findings to a moderate level.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项单一的病例报告,描述了一名67岁女性因复发性高危型HPV而接受了非标签三剂Gardasil®9系列。该研究在临床环境中进行,聚焦于一名有HPV感染史的特定患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该病例涉及将Gardasil®9 疫苗非标签用于一名67岁女性的复发性高危型HPV。通过分析患者的宫颈细胞学检查和阴道镜检查结果,评估疫苗接种对HPV状态的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在接受三剂Gardasil®9系列后,患者的宫颈细胞学检查未检测到HPV,随后的阴道镜检查也未发现任何上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤的证据。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者指出,尽管这一病例无法确立因果关系,但它引发了关于HPV 疫苗接种在老年人中潜在治疗作用的重要问题。这一病例强调了对45岁以上患者(无论是否有HPV感染史)进行HPV 疫苗接种进一步研究的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,HPV 疫苗接种可能在复发性感染的老年人中具有治疗潜力,这可能为未来扩大HPV相关癌症疫苗接种指南的研究提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于这是一个单一的病例报告案例,证据有限,无法确立因果关系。该研究缺乏对照比较和普遍适用性,这将研究结果的强度降低到中等水平。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is a highly prevalent sexually transmitted infection associated with malignancies of the cervix, vulva, and vagina. The study aimed to explore the potential therapeutic role of HPV vaccination in older adults with recurrent infections.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This is a single case report describing a 67-year-old woman with recurrent high-risk HPV who received the three-dose Gardasil®9 series off-label. The study was conducted in a clinical setting and focuses on a specific patient with a history of HPV infection.
analysis_en.methods: The case involved the administration of the Gardasil®9 vaccine off-label to a 67-year-old woman with recurrent high-risk HPV. The patient's cervical cytology and colposcopy results were used to assess the impact of vaccination on HPV status.
analysis_en.main_results: Following the three-dose Gardasil®9 series, the patient's cervical cytology was negative for HPV, and subsequent colposcopy did not demonstrate any evidence of intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors note that while this case cannot establish causality, it raises important questions about the potential therapeutic use of HPV vaccination in older adults. This case highlights the need for further research into HPV vaccination in patients over the age of 45 years with or without history of HPV infection.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that HPV vaccination may have therapeutic potential in older adults with recurrent infections, which could inform future studies on expanding vaccination guidelines for HPV-related cancers.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As this is a single case report, the evidence is limited and cannot establish causality. The study lacks controlled comparisons and generalizability, which reduces the strength of the findings to a moderate level.

papers.title_zh: 一名67岁女性复发性HPV感染中使用非标签HPV 疫苗接种的案例
papers.source_body_en: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is a highly prevalent sexually transmitted infection associated with malignancies of the cervix, vulva, and vagina. While prophylactic vaccination with Gardasil®9 is FDA-approved through age 45, no clinical trials have evaluated its use in older adults who remain sexually active and at risk for HPV-related cancers. We describe the case of a woman who presented with recurrent high-risk HPV and received the three-dose Gardasil®9 series off-label at the age of 67. Following vaccination, her cervical cytology was negative for HPV and subsequent colposcopy did not demonstrate any evidence of intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. As this is a single case report, this temporal association cannot establish that vaccination caused viral clearance. Nonetheless, this case raises important questions regarding age-based HPV vaccination limits. Immunosenescence in older populations may impair viral clearance and could increase cumulative risk of progression from dysplasia to malignancy. Vaccination may therefore serve both prophylactic and potentially therapeutic roles; however, this must be evaluated in further controlled studies. This case highlights the need for further research into HPV vaccination in patients over the age of 45 years with or without history of HPV infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)是一种与宫颈、外阴和阴道恶性肿瘤高度相关的性传播感染。尽管Gardasil®9用于预防疫苗接种的疫苗已被美国食品药品监督管理局(FDA)批准用于45岁以下人群,但尚未有临床试验评估其在保持性活跃且仍面临HPV相关癌症风险的老年人中的使用效果。我们描述了一名67岁女性因复发性高危型HPV而接受非标签三剂Gardasil®9系列的案例。在接受疫苗接种后,她的宫颈细胞学检查未检测到HPV,随后的阴道镜检查也未发现任何上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤的证据。由于这是一个单一的病例报告案例,这种时间关联无法证明疫苗接种导致了病毒清除。然而,这一案例引发了关于基于年龄的HPV 疫苗接种使用限制的重要问题。老年人群中的免疫衰老可能影响病毒清除能力,并可能增加从不典型增生进展为恶性肿瘤的累积风险。因此,疫苗接种可能同时具有预防和潜在治疗作用;然而,这一作用必须在进一步的对照研究中进行评估。这一案例强调了对45岁以上患者(无论是否有HPV感染史)进行HPV 疫苗接种进一步研究的必要性。

papers.title: Immunohistochemical detection of high-risk human papillomavirus E6/E7 oncoproteins is associated with aggressive clinicopathological features in prostate cancer: a Sudanese cohort study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The role of human papillomavirus (HPV) in prostate cancer development remains uncertain, despite accumulating evidence of a potential link in certain populations. While HPV is a known cause of several epithelial cancers, its connection to prostate cancer (PCa) has not been definitively proven. This research assessed the immunohistochemical presence of high-risk HPV E6/E7 oncoproteins in prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) tissues from a Sudanese cohort and explored their association with clinicopathological features. Methods A retrospective case-control study involved 100 prostate tissue specimens fixed in formalin and embedded in paraffin, consisting of 50 histologically confirmed PCa cases and 50 BPH controls. The expression of high-risk HPV E6/E7 proteins was assessed by immunohistochemistry with monoclonal antibodies, and staining was semi-quantitatively scored using the H-score system. The relationship between HPV immunoreactivity and clinicopathological variables was analyzed with various statistical tests, including chi-square, Mann-Whitney U tests, logistic regression, and odds ratio calculations. Results High-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was significantly more common in prostate cancer than in benign prostatic hyperplasia (48% vs. Prostate cancer tissues had over four times higher odds of HPV positivity compared to benign tissues (OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.69–10.43). Positive immunostaining was notably associated with higher Gleason Grade groups (p = 0.0035) and advanced tumor stages (p = 0.004), while no significant link was found with serum prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels. Multivariable logistic regression confirmed that higher tumor grade and pathological stage were independently associated with HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity, even after adjustment for PSA. Conclusions In this Sudanese cohort, high-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was associated with prostate cancer and more severe pathological features. These results suggest a possible connection between HPV-related protein expression and aggressive tumor traits. However, since immunohistochemistry alone cannot confirm active HPV infection or prove its causal role in prostate cancer development, caution is needed when interpreting these findings. Future research should include molecular HPV detection, viral genotyping, and RNA-based studies to better understand HPV's biological role in prostate cancer.

These results suggest a possible connection between HPV-related protein expression and aggressive tumor traits. However, since immunohistochemistry alone cannot confirm active HPV infection or prove its causal role in prostate cancer development, caution is needed when interpreting these findings. Future research should include molecular HPV detection, viral genotyping, and RNA-based studies to better understand HPV's biological role in prostate cancer.

papers.title: Association of HPV16 infection with p53 and survivin expression in oral squamous cell carcinoma
papers.abstract: Abstract Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is the most common malignancy of the oral cavity and a major public health concern worldwide. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between p53 and survivin expression, clinicopathologic parameters and HPV16 infection in OSCC in order to elucidate the potential role of HPV16 in its pathogenesis. The study enrolled 45 patients who underwent surgical treatment for histologically confirmed OSCC. Tumor specimens were formalin-fixed and paraffin-embedded (FFPE) and histologically analyzed using hematoxylin/eosin staining. Immunohistochemistry for p53 and survivin was performed using the DAKO system. DNA extracted from FFPE tumor tissues was analyzed for HPV16 genome presence using polymerase chain reaction (PCR). All patients were followed for three years after primary treatment. No statistically significant associations were observed between p53 or survivin expression and clinicopathologic parameters including age, gender, tumor site, grade, stage, recurrence, metastasis or HPV16 status ( P > 0.05). Among HPV16-positive patients (11/45, 24.4%), low survivin expression ( 10%) was observed in 7/11 (64%) patients. Disease-free interval did not differ significantly between patients with low vs. high p53 ( P = 0.220) or survivin expression ( P = 0.580). A significant correlation was detected between p53 and survivin expression ( P = 0.04). HPV16 positivity was significantly associated with the absence of p53 immunoreactivity. These findings suggest that HPV16-independent oncogenic pathways are likely predominant in OSCC, while HPV16 infection may be associated with a distinct molecular subset characterized by absent p53 expression (p53−; survivin+/−; HPV16+). These results underscore the biological heterogeneity of OSCC and may have implications for future biomarker-based stratification of patients.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the relationship between HPV16 infection and the expression of p53 and survivin in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC). The research aimed to understand the potential role of HPV16 in OSCC pathogenesis. The study included 45 patients with histologically confirmed OSCC, and tumor specimens were analyzed using immunohistochemistry and PCR. Results showed no significant associations between p53 or survivin expression and clinicopathologic parameters, but a significant correlation between p53 and survivin expression was observed. HPV16 positivity was linked to the absence of p53 immunoreactivity. The findings suggest that HPV16 may be associated with a specific molecular subset of OSCC, while other oncogenic pathways are more prevalent. These results highlight the heterogeneity of OSCC and may inform future biomarker-based patient stratification. The evidence is based on an abstract-only review, and the study's limitations are not explicitly detailed.

papers.title_zh: HPV16感染与口腔鳞状细胞癌中p53和survivin表达的关系
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is the most common malignancy of the oral cavity and a major public health concern worldwide. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between p53 and survivin expression, clinicopathologic parameters and HPV16 infection in OSCC in order to elucidate the potential role of HPV16 in its pathogenesis. The study enrolled 45 patients who underwent surgical treatment for histologically confirmed OSCC. Tumor specimens were formalin-fixed and paraffin-embedded (FFPE) and histologically analyzed using hematoxylin/eosin staining. Immunohistochemistry for p53 and survivin was performed using the DAKO system. DNA extracted from FFPE tumor tissues was analyzed for HPV16 genome presence using polymerase chain reaction (PCR). All patients were followed for three years after primary treatment. No statistically significant associations were observed between p53 or survivin expression and clinicopathologic parameters including age, gender, tumor site, grade, stage, recurrence, metastasis or HPV16 status ( P > 0.05). Among HPV16-positive patients (11/45, 24.4%), low survivin expression ( 10%) was observed in 7/11 (64%) patients. Disease-free interval did not differ significantly between patients with low vs. high p53 ( P = 0.220) or survivin expression ( P = 0.580). A significant correlation was detected between p53 and survivin expression ( P = 0.04). HPV16 positivity was significantly associated with the absence of p53 immunoreactivity. These findings suggest that HPV16-independent oncogenic pathways are likely predominant in OSCC, while HPV16 infection may be associated with a distinct molecular subset characterized by absent p53 expression (p53−; survivin+/−; HPV16+). These results underscore the biological heterogeneity of OSCC and may have implications for future biomarker-based stratification of patients.

papers.title: Distribution of high-risk human papillomavirus and its association with cervical cytological abnormalities in women from Northeast India
papers.abstract: Objectives: Despite the high incidence of cervical cancer in India, there aren't enough studies on the prevalence of the human papillomavirus (HPV). The study aimed at assessing the prevalence of high-risk HPV (hrHPV) types and their association with cytological abnormalities among the adult women of Barak Valley, Northeast India. Material and Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 562 women aged 18–50+ years and screened for nine high-risk HPV genotypes and liquid-based cytology (LBC) classified by the cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) system. Results: The overall HPV prevalence was 16.55%, with HPV-16 (12.28%) and HPV-18 as the two most common genotypes. Co-infection was observed with HPV-16 + HPV-18 (3.38%) and HPV-16 + HPV-31 (2.31%). Abnormal cytology was found in 10.1% of women in the order of CIN 1 (5.9%), CIN 2 (3.0%), and CIN 3 (1.2%). It showed a progressive increase in HPV positivity along with lesion severity ( p < 0.001). Bivariate analysis identified women reporting: nulliparous (Odds ratio [OR] = 2.21, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.27-3.85), high-parity (OR = 3.7, 95% CI = 2.11-6.5), irregular menstruation (OR = 4.72, 95% CI= 2.94-7.56), history of warts (OR = 13.8, 95% CI = 8.17-23.2), and pregnancy failure (OR = 2.33, 95% CI = 1.34-4.06) had a higher risk of acquiring HPV positivity. Conclusion: The study found a high burden of hrHPV and emphasises adopting comprehensive approaches for effective cervical cancer prevention by increasing awareness, providing vaccinations, routine screenings, implementing national policies, and funding better healthcare facilities.

Material and Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 562 women aged 18–50+ years and screened for nine high-risk HPV genotypes and liquid-based cytology (LBC) classified by the cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) system. Results: The overall HPV prevalence was 16.55%, with HPV-16 (12.28%) and HPV-18 as the two most common genotypes. Co-infection was observed with HPV-16 + HPV-18 (3.38%) and HPV-16 + HPV-31 (2.31%). Abnormal cytology was found in 10.1% of women in the order of CIN 1 (5.9%), CIN 2 (3.0%), and CIN 3 (1.2%). It showed a progressive increase in HPV positivity along with lesion severity ( p 0.001). Bivariate analysis identified women reporting: nulliparous (Odds ratio [OR] = 2.21, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.27-3.85), high-parity (OR = 3.7, 95% CI = 2.11-6.5), irregular menstruation (OR = 4.72, 95% CI= 2.94-7.56), history of warts (OR = 13.8, 95% CI = 8.17-23.2), and pregnancy failure (OR = 2.33, 95% CI = 1.34-4.06) had a higher risk of acquiring HPV positivity. Conclusion: The study found a high burden of hrHPV and emphasises adopting comprehensive approaches for effective cervical cancer prevention by increasing awareness, providing vaccinations, routine screenings, implementing national policies, and funding better healthcare facilities.

elements_zh.main_results: 细胞学异常在10.1%的女性中被发现,按CIN分级依次为CIN 1(5.9%)、CIN 2(3.0%)和CIN 3(1.2%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Bivariate analysis identified women reporting: nulliparous (Odds ratio [OR] = 2.21, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.27-3.85), high-parity (OR = 3.7, 95% CI = 2.11-6.5), irregular menstruation (OR = 4.72, 95% CI= 2.94-7.56), history of warts (OR = 13.8, 95% CI = 8.17-23.2), and pregnancy failure (OR = 2.33, 95% CI = 1.34-4.06) had a higher risk of acquiring HPV positivity.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究发现高危型HPV的高患病负担,并强调通过提高意识、提供疫苗接种、常规筛查、实施国家政策以及资助更好的医疗设施,采取综合措施以有效预防宫颈癌。

Results: The overall HPV prevalence was 16.55%, with HPV-16 (12.28%) and HPV-18 as the two most common genotypes. Co-infection was observed with HPV-16 + HPV-18 (3.38%) and HPV-16 + HPV-31 (2.31%). Abnormal cytology was found in 10.1% of women in the order of CIN 1 (5.9%), CIN 2 (3.0%), and CIN 3 (1.2%). It showed a progressive increase in HPV positivity along with lesion severity ( p < 0.001). Bivariate analysis identified women reporting: nulliparous (Odds ratio [OR] = 2.21, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.27-3.85), high-parity (OR = 3.7, 95% CI = 2.11-6.5), irregular menstruation (OR = 4.72, 95% CI= 2.94-7.56), history of warts (OR = 13.8, 95% CI = 8.17-23.2), and pregnancy failure (OR = 2.33, 95% CI = 1.34-4.06) had a higher risk of acquiring HPV positivity. Conclusion: The study found a high burden of hrHPV and emphasises adopting comprehensive approaches for effective cervical cancer prevention by increasing awareness, providing vaccinations, routine screenings, implementing national policies, and funding better healthcare facilities.

papers.title: Role of selected interleukins and hormonal biomarkers in screening for human papillomavirus infection and cervical cancer in women
papers.abstract: The roles of immunological and hormonal indicators in screening women with HPV infection and cervical cancer (CC) were investigated. The present study was conducted in Diyala Province during the period from January to March 2026. A total of 90 blood samples were collected from women who visited Al-Batoul Teaching Hospital and women's clinics. Serum levels of IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen, as well as HPV, were detected using ELISA and the Biorex technique. HPV-infected women represented 43.33% of the participants, women with HPV and CC represented 10.00%, and HPV-negative women represented 46.67%. No significant differences (p > 0.05) were observed among the study groups regarding marital status, number of children, chronic diseases, and smoking. The highest levels of IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen were observed in women with HPV and CC, followed by HPV-infected women, and then the control group. Exploratory ROC curve analysis showed high within-sample discriminatory performance for IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen in differentiating HPV-infected women from controls and women with HPV-associated cervical cancer from controls. However, the cutoff values, sensitivity, and specificity estimates were derived and evaluated using the same study cohort and should therefore be considered exploratory rather than clinically validated diagnostic measures. Spearman's rank correlation analysis in HPV-infected women showed a significant negative correlation between IL-1β and estrogen (ρ = −0.430, P = 0.006), and significant positive correlations between IL-2R and estrogen (ρ = 0.386, P = 0.015) and between FSH and estrogen (ρ = 0.600, P < 0.001). No statistically significant correlations were observed among the investigated biomarkers in the HPV-associated cervical cancer subgroup. Overall, HPV positivity and HPV-associated cervical cancer were associated with higher serum levels of IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen in the present cohort. Further studies using larger independent cohorts are required to determine the clinical relevance of these findings.

A total of 90 blood samples were collected from women who visited Al-Batoul Teaching Hospital and women's clinics. Serum levels of IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen, as well as HPV, were detected using ELISA and the Biorex technique. HPV-infected women represented 43.33% of the participants, women with HPV and CC represented 10.00%, and HPV-negative women represented 46.67%. No significant differences (p > 0.05) were observed among the study groups regarding marital status, number of children, chronic diseases, and smoking. The highest levels of IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen were observed in women with HPV and CC, followed by HPV-infected women, and then the control group. Exploratory ROC curve analysis showed high within-sample discriminatory performance for IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen in differentiating HPV-infected women from controls and women with HPV-associated cervical cancer from controls. However, the cutoff values, sensitivity, and specificity estimates were derived and evaluated using the same study cohort and should therefore be considered exploratory rather than clinically validated diagnostic measures. Spearman's rank correlation analysis in HPV-infected women showed a significant negative correlation between IL-1β and estrogen (ρ = −0.430, P = 0.006), and significant positive correlations between IL-2R and estrogen (ρ = 0.386, P = 0.015) and between FSH and estrogen (ρ = 0.600, P < 0.001). No statistically significant correlations were observed among the investigated biomarkers in the HPV-associated cervical cancer subgroup. Overall, HPV positivity and HPV-associated cervical cancer were associated with higher serum levels of IL-1β, IL-2R, FSH, and estrogen in the present cohort. Further studies using larger independent cohorts are required to determine the clinical relevance of these findings.

papers.abstract_zh: 本研究调查了免疫学和激素指标在筛选人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染和宫颈癌(CC)女性中的作用。本研究于2026年1月至3月在迪亚拉省进行,共从访问Al-Batoul教学医院和妇女诊所的女性中收集了90份血液样本。使用ELISA和Biorex技术检测了IL-1β、IL-2R、FSH、雌激素以及HPV的血清水平。HPV感染女性占参与者的43.33%,同时患有HPV和CC的女性占10.00%,HPV阴性女性占46.67%。在婚姻状况、子女数量、慢性疾病和吸烟方面,各研究组之间未观察到显著差异(p > 0.05)。在同时患有HPV和CC的女性中观察到IL-1β、IL-2R、FSH和雌激素的最高水平,其次是HPV感染女性,最后是对照组。探索性ROC曲线分析显示,IL-1β、IL-2R、FSH和雌激素在区分HPV感染女性与对照组以及HPV相关宫颈癌女性与对照组方面具有高样本内判别性能。然而,截断值、灵敏度和特异度估计值是使用相同研究队列研究得出并评估的,因此应被视为探索性而非临床验证的诊断措施。在HPV感染女性中进行的Spearman等级相关分析显示,IL-1β与雌激素之间存在显著负相关(ρ = −0.430,P = 0.006),IL-2R与雌激素之间存在显著正相关(ρ = 0.386,P = 0.015),FSH与雌激素之间也存在显著正相关(ρ = 0.600,P < 0.001)。在HPV相关宫颈癌亚组中,未观察到所研究生物标志物之间存在显著统计学相关性。总体而言,HPV阳性及HPV相关宫颈癌与IL-1β、IL-2R、FSH和雌激素的较高血清水平相关。需要进一步使用更大的独立队列研究进行研究,以确定这些发现的临床相关性。

papers.title: Prevalence of human papillomavirus in the public health system of the central-northern region of Chile
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE Previously, we found a high prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the private health system. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the frequency of HR-HPV in a large cohort of women attending the public health system and to compare these findings. METHODS A total of 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique. RESULTS The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection between 2020 and 2024 was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with annual values of 13.07%, 12.64%, 14.80%, 14.24%, and 14.15% in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. In women under 25 years of age, the prevalence of HR-HPV was 34.03% during the evaluated period, compared to 16.35% in women aged 25 to 44 years, 10.47% in those aged 45 to 64 years, and 11.52% in women over 64 years of age. Pap smears showed 89.71% NILM results in HPV-negative women, compared to 74.59% in HPV-positive women. The rates of LSIL and HSIL were 0.14% and 0.07% in HPV-negative women, respectively; however, these values increased to 4.73% and 4.43% in HPV-positive women, respectively. Probable carcinoma was found in only 0.006% of HPV-negative women, but in 0.46% of HPV-positive women. CONCLUSIONS The prevalence of HR-HPV infection in women attending the public health system in the central-northern region appears to be similar to that previously reported in Chile, but lower than that reported in the same region for women attending the private health system.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to determine the frequency of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the public health system, as previous research had found a high prevalence in the private health system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study analyzed 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 in the central-northern region of Chile.
analysis.methods: Samples were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique to detect HR-HPV infection and cytological abnormalities.
analysis.main_results: The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with higher rates in women under 25 years (34.03%) compared to older age groups. HPV-positive women had significantly higher rates of LSIL (4.73% vs. 0.14%) and HSIL (4.43% vs. 0.07%) than HPV-negative women.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that HR-HPV prevalence in the public health system was similar to previously reported national rates but lower than in the private health system in the same region, highlighting potential disparities in HPV infection rates between healthcare systems.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings inform public health surveillance and resource allocation by providing age-stratified prevalence data, which can guide targeted screening and prevention strategies for HPV-related diseases in the public health system.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's strength lies in its large sample size and longitudinal design, but limitations include potential selection bias as only women attending gynecological check-ups were included, and the evidence is moderate due to the abstract-only nature of the report.

analysis.summary_en: This study determined the prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in 39,512 women attending Chile's public health system between 2020-2024. The overall HR-HPV prevalence was 13.70%, with significantly higher rates in women under 25 years (34.03%) compared to older age groups. HPV-positive women had markedly increased rates of cytological abnormalities, including LSIL (4.73% vs. 0.14%) and HSIL (4.43% vs. 0.07%) compared to HPV-negative women. The prevalence was similar to national rates but lower than previously reported in the private health system, suggesting potential healthcare disparities. These findings provide valuable data for public health planning and targeted screening programs.

papers.title: Effectiveness of motivational interviewing in reducing unmet reproductive health needs among women with human papillomavirus infection: A triple-blind randomized controlled trial
papers.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of motivational interviewing (MI) in reducing unmet reproductive health needs among women with human papillomavirus (HPV) infection. Methods: This triple-blind randomized controlled trial was conducted in 2023 with confirmed HPV infection attending a women's clinic in Iran. Participants were randomly assigned to either an intervention group receiving five weekly individual MI sessions or a control group receiving routine education. Reproductive health needs were assessed at baseline and five weeks after the intervention using a validated questionnaire. Analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) was used to compare post-intervention outcomes after adjusting for baseline scores. Results: Sixty-two women were included. Baseline characteristics were similar between groups. Compared with the control group, women receiving MI showed significantly lower total reproductive health needs scores after the intervention ( P <0.001), with a large effect size (partial η 2 =0.642). Significant improvements were observed across all 12 domains, particularly in psychological health education, male involvement in reproductive health, and women's empowerment. Conclusion: MI effectively reduced unmet reproductive health needs among women with HPV infection and may be integrated into routine sexual and reproductive healthcare to enhance counseling, psychological support, and patient empowerment. Study registration: The trial was registered with the Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials: IRCT20230531058348N1.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年在伊朗一家妇女诊所中开展了一项三盲随机对照试验,纳入了确诊HPV感染的参与者。共纳入62名女性,她们被随机分配至干预组(接受五次每周一次的个体动机访谈)或对照组(接受常规教育)。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用经过验证的问卷在基线和干预后五周评估生殖健康需求。采用协方差分析(ANCOVA)比较干预后结果,并调整基线得分。
analysis_zh.main_results: 与对照组相比,接受MI的女性在干预后表现出显著更低的总体生殖健康需求评分(P <0.001),具有较大的效应量(部分η2=0.642)。所有12个领域均观察到显著改善,尤其是在心理卫生教育、男性在生殖健康中的参与以及女性赋权方面。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为动机访谈有效减少了HPV感染女性的未满足生殖健康需求的证据,表明其可能可以整合到常规的性与生殖健康护理中。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于将动机访谈整合到常规的性与生殖健康护理中,以增强对HPV感染女性的咨询、心理支持和患者赋权。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅在伊朗一家诊所中进行,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。由于样本量有限以及非随机设置中可能存在偏倚,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: High diagnostic concordance between vulvar and cervical samples for human papillomavirus detection: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Low compliance with clinician-collected cervical sampling and implementation barriers in resource-limited settings limit human papillomavirus (HPV)-based cervical cancer prevention. Vulvar sampling is non-invasive and easier to perform, but its agreement with cervical HPV testing remains insufficiently defined. We retrospectively analyzed 719 paired vulvar and cervical specimens tested by clinically validated fluorescence PCR to evaluate concordance between sampling sites and the potential utility of vulvar HPV testing. High-risk HPV (hrHPV) positivity was 47.98% (345/719) in vulvar samples and 43.53% (313/719) in cervical samples, with strong site-to-site concordance (κ = 0.821). The negative predictive value of vulvar hrHPV testing for concurrent cervical hrHPV positivity was 95.72%. Concordance was highest for HPV18 (κ = 0.892; negative predictive value [NPV] = 99.41%), followed by HPV16 (κ = 0.839), and low-risk HPV6/11 (κ = 0.746). Among five biopsy-confirmed cervical intraepithelial neoplasia cases, vulvar and cervical HPV results were fully concordant. Age-stratified analysis showed peak hrHPV infection in women younger than 30 years. In women aged 40–49 years, vulvar hrHPV positivity exceeded cervical positivity (56.52% vs 45.65%). Agreement was lower among women aged ≥40 years for hrHPV and lrHPV testing. Among discordant cases, 93.75% (15/16) of vulvar-negative/cervical-positive cases had prior HPV-related treatment, whereas non-HPV16/18 types predominated in vulvar-positive/cervical-negative cases (91.67%, 44/48). Vulvar HPV testing showed high concordance with paired cervical testing and may help identify women at low likelihood of concurrent cervical hrHPV positivity. These findings support prospective evaluation of vulvar sampling as a non-invasive adjunct for HPV testing, particularly for women with low acceptance of cervical sampling or limited access to conventional screening. IMPORTANCE Conventional cervical human papillomavirus (HPV) screening remains inaccessible to some women because of discomfort, perceived invasiveness, privacy concerns, and implementation barriers. This study shows that HPV testing with vulvar swabs, a truly non-invasive sampling site, has high concordance with paired cervical testing (κ = 0.821). The high negative predictive value of vulvar high-risk HPV (hrHPV) testing for concurrent cervical hrHPV negativity (95.72%) suggests that a negative vulvar result may identify women at low likelihood of cervical hrHPV positivity, potentially reducing unnecessary referrals. These findings are relevant for older and postmenopausal women, in whom cervical atrophy may decrease the sensitivity of HPV detection. Overall, our results provide preliminary support for prospective evaluation of vulvar sampling as a patient-friendly adjunct to HPV testing, particularly for women with low acceptance of cervical sampling or limited access to conventional screening. Population-based validation with cytological and histological endpoints is required before broader implementation.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 对临床医生采集的宫颈取样的依从性低,并且在资源有限的环境中实施障碍限制了基于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的 宫颈癌 预防。外阴取样是非侵入性的,更容易进行,但其与宫颈 HPV 检测的一致性仍不明确。我们回顾性分析了 719 份配对的外阴和宫颈标本,这些标本通过经过临床验证的荧光 PCR 检测,以评估采样点之间的一致性以及外阴 HPV 检测的潜在效用。外阴样本中 高危型HPV (hrHPV) 阳性率为 47.98% (345/719),宫颈样本中 高危型HPV (hrHPV) 阳性率为 43.53% (313/719),具有很强的位点一致性 (κ = 0.821)。外阴 hrHPV 检测对并发宫颈 hrHPV 阳性的阴性预测值为 95.72%。HPV18 的一致性最高(κ = 0.892;阴性预测值 [NPV] = 99.41%),其次是 HPV16(κ = 0.839)和低危 HPV6/11(κ = 0.746)。在 5 例活检确诊的宫颈上皮内瘤变病例中,外阴和宫颈 HPV 结果完全一致。年龄分层分析显示 30 岁以下女性的 hrHPV 感染高峰。在40-49岁的女性中,外阴hrHPV阳性率超过宫颈阳性率(56.52% vs 45.65%)。年龄≥40 岁的女性对 hrHPV 和 lrHPV 检测的一致性较低。在不一致的病例中,93.75%(15/16)的外阴阴性/宫颈阳性病例既往有HPV相关治疗,而非HPV16/18类型在外阴阳性/宫颈阴性病例中占主导地位(91.67%,44/48)。外阴 HPV 检测与配对宫颈检测高度一致,可能有助于识别同时宫颈 hrHPV 阳性可能性较低的女性。这些发现支持对外阴取样作为 HPV 检测的非侵入性辅助手段进行前瞻性评估,特别是对于宫颈取样接受度较低或传统筛查机会有限的女性。重要性 由于不适、感知到的侵入性、隐私问题和实施障碍,一些女性仍然无法进行传统的宫颈 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 筛查。这项研究表明,使用外阴拭子进行 HPV 检测(真正的非侵入性采样点)与配对宫颈检测具有很高的一致性(κ = 0.821)。外阴 高危型HPV (hrHPV) 检测对并发宫颈 hrHPV 阴性的高阴性预测值 (95.72%) 表明,阴性外阴结果可能会识别出宫颈 hrHPV 阳性可能性较低的女性,从而可能减少不必要的转诊。这些发现与老年和绝经后女性相关,宫颈萎缩可能会降低 HPV 检测的敏感性。总体而言,我们的结果为外阴取样作为 HPV 检测的患者友好型辅助手段的前瞻性评估提供了初步支持,特别是对于宫颈取样接受度较低或常规筛查机会有限的女性。在更广泛的实施之前,需要使用细胞学和组织学终点进行基于人群的验证。

papers.title: Self-collected cervical samples for detection of high-risk human papillomavirus: A community outreach approach in a remote region
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Self collection of cervical samples is evolving as a potential screening approach to overcome cultural, geographical and logistical barriers that contribute to poor screening uptake. We conducted a study to compare performance of self and physician-collected cervical samples for high-risk human papillomavirus (hr-HPV) detection through community outreach approach in the hilly terrains of Sikkim. Methods A prospective longitudinal study was conducted for 2 y, sampling 210 sexually active women aged 18-65 y attending Central Referral Hospital and 3 district hospitals in Sikkim. Paired self and physician collected cervical samples were taken from consenting women for HPV DNA and pap test. Women who had total hysterectomy, diagnosed with cancer or were pregnant were excluded. Colposcopy was done among those positive for HPV infection. Result Prevalence of HPV (HPV DNA ± pap) was 17% (36/210) in this study of which HPV 16 was the most common variant (n=4,15%). Physician collected samples had the highest HPV detection rate (n=26,12%). Sensitivity and specificity were highest with physician-collected samples (71.4%, and 76.9%, respectively). Concordance between physician and self-sampling was good (Kappa 0.7). Women lost to follow up for colposcopy was 36% (n=13). Interpretation and conclusions Performance of physician-sampling was better than self-sampling and pap in the detection of hr-HPV. Physician-sampling should be used for HPV DNA detection when feasible.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of self-collected cervical samples compared to physician-collected samples for detecting high-risk human papillomavirus (hr-HPV) in a remote region of Sikkim. The research focused on improving screening uptake by addressing cultural, geographical, and logistical barriers. A prospective longitudinal study was conducted over two years, involving 210 sexually active women aged 18-65 years. The study found that HPV prevalence was 17%, with HPV 16 being the most common variant. Physician-collected samples showed higher HPV detection rates and better sensitivity and specificity compared to self-sampling and pap tests. The concordance between physician and self-sampling was good, with a Kappa value of 0.7. The study concluded that physician-sampling is more effective for hr-HPV detection. However, 36% of women were lost to follow-up for colposcopy, which may affect the completeness of the results. The findings suggest that physician-collected samples should be used for HPV DNA detection when feasible, highlighting the importance of trained personnel in ensuring accurate screening outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景和目的 自我采集宫颈样本作为一种潜在的筛查方法正在发展,以克服文化、地理和物流障碍,从而提高筛查参与率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们开展了一项研究,通过社区推广方法比较自我采集和医生采集的宫颈样本在高危型HPV检测中的表现。这项前瞻性纵向研究持续了2年,共采集了210名18-65岁性活跃女性的宫颈样本,这些女性在锡金的中央转诊医院和3家区级医院就诊。已接受全子宫切除术、被诊断为癌症或怀孕的女性被排除在外。
elements_zh.methods: 从同意的女性中采集了配对的自我采集和医生采集的宫颈样本,用于HPV DNA检测和巴氏涂片检查。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果 在这项研究中,HPV(HPV DNA ± 巴氏涂片)的检出率为17%(36/210),其中HPV 16是最常见的亚型(n=4,15%)。医生采集的样本具有最高的HPV检出率(n=26,12%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 解释和结论 在高危型HPV检测中,医生采集样本的表现优于自我采集和巴氏涂片。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在可行的情况下,应使用医生采集样本进行HPV DNA检测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 有36%(n=13)的女性未能完成阴道镜检查随访。

papers.title_zh: 用于高危型HPV检测的自我采集宫颈样本:在锡金山区开展的社区推广方法
papers.source_body_en: Background and objectives Self collection of cervical samples is evolving as a potential screening approach to overcome cultural, geographical and logistical barriers that contribute to poor screening uptake. We conducted a study to compare performance of self and physician-collected cervical samples for high-risk human papillomavirus (hr-HPV) detection through community outreach approach in the hilly terrains of Sikkim. Methods A prospective longitudinal study was conducted for 2 y, sampling 210 sexually active women aged 18-65 y attending Central Referral Hospital and 3 district hospitals in Sikkim. Paired self and physician collected cervical samples were taken from consenting women for HPV DNA and pap test. Women who had total hysterectomy, diagnosed with cancer or were pregnant were excluded. Colposcopy was done among those positive for HPV infection. Result Prevalence of HPV (HPV DNA ± pap) was 17% (36/210) in this study of which HPV 16 was the most common variant (n=4,15%). Physician collected samples had the highest HPV detection rate (n=26,12%). Sensitivity and specificity were highest with physician-collected samples (71.4%, and 76.9%, respectively). Concordance between physician and self-sampling was good (Kappa 0.7). Women lost to follow up for colposcopy was 36% (n=13). Interpretation and conclusions Performance of physician-sampling was better than self-sampling and pap in the detection of hr-HPV. Physician-sampling should be used for HPV DNA detection when feasible.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的 自我采集宫颈样本作为一种潜在的筛查方法正在发展,以克服文化、地理和物流障碍,从而提高筛查参与率。我们在锡金山区的山地地形中开展了一项研究,通过社区推广方法比较自我采集和医生采集的宫颈样本在高危型HPV检测中的表现。方法 这是一项前瞻性纵向研究,持续了2年,共采集了210名18-65岁性活跃女性的宫颈样本,这些女性在锡金的中央转诊医院和3家区级医院就诊。从同意的女性中采集了配对的自我采集和医生采集的宫颈样本,用于HPV DNA检测和巴氏涂片检查。已接受全子宫切除术、被诊断为癌症或怀孕的女性被排除在外。对HPV感染阳性的女性进行了阴道镜检查。结果 在这项研究中,HPV(HPV DNA ± 巴氏涂片)的检出率为17%(36/210),其中HPV 16是最常见的亚型(n=4,15%)。医生采集的样本具有最高的HPV检出率(n=26,12%)。自我采集和医生采集样本的敏感性和特异性均最高(分别为71.4%和76.9%)。医生与自我采集样本之间的符合度良好(Kappa值为0.7)。有36%(n=13)的女性未能完成阴道镜检查随访。解释和结论 在高危型HPV检测中,医生采集样本的表现优于自我采集和巴氏涂片。在可行的情况下,应使用医生采集样本进行HPV DNA检测。

papers.title: Knowledge, attitude and practice on human papilloma virus vaccination: A cross-sectional study among second year MBBS students in India
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection remains a major public health concern because of its strong association with cervical cancer and other HPV-related malignancies. Therefore, it is of interest to assess the knowledge, attitudes and practices regarding HPV vaccination among 150 second-year MBBS students using a questionnaire-based cross-sectional design. Most participants showed good awareness of cervical cancer and HPV vaccination, with 96.7% having heard of cervical cancer and 93.3% correctly identifying the primary purpose of HPV vaccination. A positive attitude toward vaccination was observed, as 95.3% supported inclusion of the HPV vaccine in the routine immunization schedule, although important gaps remained regarding high-risk groups, vaccination timing and personal vaccine uptake. Thus, data shows the need for strengthened medical education and continuous training to improve HPV vaccination awareness and cervical cancer prevention practices among future healthcare professionals.
